question: Which of the following terms define the Real National Income?
solution:
The correct answer is __**GDP at constant price**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **GDP at constant price** is used to measure the Real National Income.
 
• It refers to the value of goods and services produced in an economy, adjusted for changes in price level or inflation.
 
• This adjustment allows for the comparison of economic output from one year to another without the distortion caused by inflation.
 
• Constant prices
